title: Guided alert creation with runbook snippets and cost forecast
creator: Maya Lin
description: Problem: customers struggle to create actionable alerts in the Console that (1) consistently capture SLO-relevant context, (2) contain a concise on-call runbook snippet, and (3) predict the cost impact of alert-induced remediation actions (e.g., failover to dedicated capacity or scale-up operations). Goals: 1) lower time-to-incident-resolution by surfacing runbook snippets and quick-play actions during alert creation; 2) reduce noisy/low-value alerts by showing SLO alignment and projected cost delta; 3) enable straightforward handoffs by pinning postmortem and playbook links into the alert metadata. Constraints: avoid increasing cognitive load on alert creators, preserve minimal-first-user flow for quick alert setup, and integrate without rippling large backend schema changes. Proposed solution: add a guided Alert Creation flow with three collapsible panes — Context & SLO alignment, Runbook snippet (editable), and Cost Forecast. The SLO pane shows related SLOs detected by service selector or tag (with a picker), past breach frequency, and recommended thresholds. The Runbook pane allows authors to paste a 1-3 step quick remediation, choose a runbook template, and link a longer postmortem doc. The Cost Forecast pane simulates potential immediate and 24h cost delta for actions tied to the alert (e.g., scale-to X, fallback-to-model-Y, route-to-dedicated). UI details: compact card for summary, expandable full editor for advanced configs, tooltip microcopy for terms like "cost forecast (estimate)" and "SLO alignment (probabilistic)", and optional automatic inclusion of recent error-rate graphs. Trade-offs and decisions: - Keep default flow single-step (Context) with secondary links to Runbook and Cost Forecast to reduce friction for quick alerts. - Cost numbers are estimations (rounded) to avoid users treating them as billing guarantees; label clearly. - Automatic SLO suggestions use heuristics (tag-based + similarity); explicit confirmation needed to link SLO. - For now, store runbook snippets as metadata strings attached to alerts to avoid immediate large schema refactors; plan for normalized runbook objects in a follow-up iteration. Edge cases: for private deployments (VPC) we hide cost forecast unless telemetry is available. Accessibility: keyboard-first, ARIA labels for panes, and 2x contrast for badges.
acceptance_criteria: New alert creation flow available behind feature flag 'guided_alerts' in console-2025.03
SLO alignment pane populates suggestions for >70% of services with SLOs
Runbook snippet editor allows saving 1-3 steps and links to a postmortem URL
Cost Forecast shows estimated immediate and 24h delta with explanatory tooltip
Created alert metadata includes runbook snippet and linked postmortem URL
Design handoff files (Figma) and component spec delivered to frontend with CSS variables
comments: 2025-02-19 — Initial kickoff with PM and Eng. PM (Priya Rao) emphasized need for 'quick-create' alerts that don't block dev velocity. Eng (Rafael Ortiz) noted backend may need small schema flag for runbook_snippet but prefers metadata approach.

2025-02-25 — Prototype 1 uploaded to Figma. UX session with 6 engineers and 3 oncallers: main feedback was to avoid showing cost forecast by default and to give an 'estimate' label. Also asked for a compact summary card for the Alerts list view.

2025-02-28 — Feasibility sync: backend to add 'alert_metadata' free-form map; SRE raised concern about storing URLs without validation — agreed to add a simple whitelist check for internal links and a warning for external links.

2025-03-03 — Design update: swapped pane ordering so runbook is adjacent to SLO alignment (per oncall feedback). Added quick presets for runbook templates: 'Restart', 'Scale-up', 'Rollback', 'Investigate logs'.

2025-03-06 — Design review with product: minor copy changes to SLO pane to highlight breach probability. Decided to ship behind feature flag and gate cost forecast by deployment telemetry availability. Request from Legal to include 'cost estimate is non-binding' microcopy; added to tooltip.
2025-03-07 — PRD link and Figma link added to ticket; design handoff scheduled for 2025-03-10. Moving to In Review.
notes_for_engineering: Frontend to implement collapsible panes with lazy loading of graphs. Use existing Alert metadata schema field 'alert_metadata' as a temporary store (see ENG-22490). Cost forecast endpoints are mocked behind feature flag 'cost_preview' until ENG-22911 completes. Add telemetry events: alert.create.guided_used, alert.create.linked_slo, alert.create.runbook_saved.
handoff_artifacts: Figma: Guided alert creation (v2) — frames: onboarding, quick-create, runbook-edit
